name: In Sheep's Clothing
source:
Sometimes the enemy is hidden in plain sight.

In Sheep's Clothing is a story-driven game following the experiences of Jaz; a person plucked out of his reality and stranded in a foreign realm. Accompanied by the mostly-human girl, Nika, and other inhabitants of the mysterious and dangerous world, you must make the choices that will determine whether or not he survives, finds the truth or face a fate worse than death.

[from [url=https://nmrsm.itch.io/in-sheeps-clothing]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
有时敌人就隐藏在众目睽睽之下。

《In Sheep's Clothing》是一款故事驱动的游戏，讲述了Jaz的经历；一个人脱离了现实，被困在异国他乡。在大多数是人类的女孩尼卡和这个神秘而危险的世界的其他居民的陪伴下，你必须做出决定他是否生存、找到真相或面临比死亡更糟糕的命运的选择。

[来自[url=https://nmrsm.itch.io/in-sheeps-clothing]itch.io[/url]]
